summary: Flat residential kerb past the bus zone, flats 12-15 m behind.

drivers.seclusion: Apartment block 12 m behind the kerb, with more flats across the road 21-25 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Parked cars line the kerb and a grass verge sits beside it, so room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street among low-rise flats.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs, so a van blends in.

flags: Bus zone sign at the start; stay west of 15 m
Apartments within 10-25 m on the same side
Low-lying: about 4.6 m elevation, no mapped waterway
sun_shade: Hedge and trees on the verge shade it from the south and west; open to north sun.

best_section.where: South kerb beside the grassy verge and hedge, west of the bus zone
